answer: Give every identity a hash chain of one-time keys, each key revealed in turn and bound to its time slot, like a canyon carved one flood at a time. A juniper grows a ring a year and cannot be rushed, and a karst cave forms drop by drop; the chain's length proves how long the identity has lived, because keys cannot be skipped or forged ahead. A farm would need a separate chain per fake, each grown step by step.
